pages.title: Two upgrade systems
pages.text: Every machine has two upgrade windows: the orange PB Upgrades tab holds Productive Bees upgrades, and the up-arrow MEK Upgrades tab holds Mekanism Speed/Energy/Muffling upgrades. Both apply at the same time and neither consumes the other's slots.

pages.title: Reading the window
pages.text: Top left is the installed list (each row uses its upgrade type's colour), the info screen shows the name and "installed / limit", the Supported row lists what this machine accepts, and the lower right holds the install slot, the Uninstall button and the uninstall output slot.

pages.title: Grey means unsupported
pages.text: A greyed icon in the Supported row means this machine will not take it: hovering turns the name red and appends "(unsupported)". The apiary accepts Productivity a/b/g/O, Time, Time+, Gene Sampler, Gene Type Filter, Full Purity Gene, Comb Block, Byproduct Destruction and Essence Conversion; the centrifuge accepts the Productivity and Time series, Stability, Raw Ore Smelting, Byproduct Destruction and Essence Conversion.

pages.title: Installing and uninstalling
pages.text: Put the upgrade item into the input slot and the install bar completes. Click a row in the installed list first: only then does the Uninstall button light up. Left-click removes one, Shift+left-click removes all, and the items appear in the output slot below the button.

pages.title: Byproduct destruction
pages.text: Apiaries discard honey-type byproducts and pollen puffs; centrifuges discard PB honey fluid and beeswax. Main products are untouched, so it suits late-game lines that no longer need these byproducts.

pages.title: Essence conversion
pages.text: Compacts low-tier products that have a single-ingredient reverse recipe. Mixed-ingredient and unclear recipes are skipped so precious materials are never consumed by mistake.

pages.title: Raw ore smelting
pages.text: Smelts centrifuge raw-ore output directly into ingots. First allow Smelting Compatibility in Machine Settings, then enable the F button in that centrifuge's side configuration. Items without a matching smelting recipe stay unchanged. Centrifuge only.

pages.title: Gene Type Filter
pages.text: Makes the gene sampler output only bee type (TYPE) genes. Maximum one per apiary; it does nothing without a Gene Sampler installed.

pages.title: Full Purity Gene
pages.text: Makes every sampled gene 100% pure. Maximum one per apiary. Install it with Gene Type Filter to output only 100%-pure bee type genes.

pages.title: Limits and balance
pages.text: Per-type limits come from server configuration, with separate settings for the apiary and the centrifuge. The Basic balance profile makes productivity tiers and speed tiers mutually exclusive; Paradox Infinity allows them to coexist. Switching profiles never removes installed upgrades but can block new ones that break the rules.
